name: exp_3sto
summary: An Expert Advisor that uses three Stochastic oscillators across different timeframes to generate trading signals. It aligns signals from higher timeframes for trend direction and lower timeframes for entry timing, executing trades when all three Stochastic conditions are met simultaneously.
summary_zh: 该EA使用三个不同周期的随机指标(Stochastic)产生交易信号,通过高周期判断趋势方向、低周期确定入场时机,当三个随机指标条件同时满足时执行交易。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于三重随机指标共振,通过在三个不同时间周期上部署Stochastic振荡器来确认趋势方向和入场时机。入场条件通常要求高周期Stochastic显示上升趋势(如K线在D线上方且处于超卖区向上交叉),中周期Stochastic确认动量方向,低周期Stochastic提供精确入场信号。出场条件可能包括Stochastic反向交叉、达到预设止盈止损、或高周期趋势反转信号。仓位管理可能采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位,但具体取决于参数设置。资金管理方面,三重过滤机制本身提供了一定的信号质量保障,但若无动态仓位调整和风险控制机制,在极端行情下仍可能面临较大回撤风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on triple Stochastic convergence across three different timeframes, deploying Stochastic oscillators on higher, medium, and lower timeframes to confirm trend direction and entry timing. Entry conditions typically require the higher-timeframe Stochastic to show an uptrend (e.g., K line crossing above D line from oversold territory), the medium-timeframe Stochastic to confirm momentum direction, and the lower-timeframe Stochastic to provide a precise entry trigger. Exit conditions may include Stochastic reverse crossovers, reaching preset take-profit or stop-loss levels, or higher-timeframe trend reversal signals. Position sizing likely uses fixed lots or account-balance-proportional sizing depending on parameter configuration. Money management relies on the triple-filter mechanism for signal quality assurance, but without dynamic position adjustment and comprehensive risk controls, significant drawdowns may occur during extreme market conditions.

parameters.name: Stoch_Slowing
parameters.description: 随机指标慢速平滑周期

pros: 三重随机指标共振过滤减少了假信号,提高了入场质量
多周期分析框架符合自顶向下的交易逻辑,趋势跟随效果较好
策略逻辑直观易懂,参数可调性较强,便于优化和适应不同市场环境
pros_en: Triple Stochastic convergence filter reduces false signals and improves entry quality
Multi-timeframe analysis framework follows top-down trading logic with good trend-following performance
Strategy logic is intuitive and easy to understand with adjustable parameters for optimization across different market conditions
cons: 三重过滤条件可能导致信号过少,在震荡市中可能长期无交易
随机指标在强趋势市场中容易产生频繁的超买超卖假信号导致逆势交易
过度优化三个时间周期的参数组合容易导致过拟合,实盘表现可能偏离回测结果
cons_en: Triple filter conditions may produce too few signals, potentially leaving long periods without trades in ranging markets
Stochastic oscillators tend to generate frequent false overbought/oversold signals in strong trending markets, leading to counter-trend trades
Over-optimizing the parameter combination across three timeframes risks overfitting, causing live performance to deviate from backtesting results
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器(如均线或ATR)以区分趋势行情和震荡行情,避免在不利市场环境中产生错误信号
引入动态仓位管理和追踪止损机制,根据波动率调整风险敞口,提升资金管理能力
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (such as moving averages or ATR) to distinguish trending from ranging markets, avoiding false signals in unfavorable conditions
Introduce dynamic position sizing and trailing stop mechanisms, adjusting risk exposure based on volatility to improve money management

risk_points: 三重随机指标共振可能在高周期产生滞后的反转信号导致入场延迟
如果缺乏新K线检查机制,同一根K线上可能重复开仓导致仓位失控
随机指标在极端单边行情中持续超买超卖,可能反复触发逆势信号造成连续亏损
risk_points_en: Triple Stochastic convergence may produce lagging reversal signals on higher timeframes, causing delayed entries
Without a new bar check mechanism, repeated position opening on the same bar may lead to uncontrolled exposure
Stochastic may persistently trigger counter-trend signals in extreme trending markets, causing consecutive losses
